author: OpenStreetMap contributors; heights produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA
changes: Derived database built by tools/track-pipeline/build.py monza: OSM circuit relation 284565 and pit way 38168747 chained, projected, smoothed and resampled every 2 m; s scaled to 5793 m; heights from the Copernicus GLO-30 tile with a 300 m opening, 90 m average and 20 m Gaussian; gravel and barriers from OSM ways near the track; authored widths, banking, kerbs, run-off kinds, barrier types and offsets, pit widths, limit lines, boxes and grid; timing line measured on the FIA 2025 circuit map; environment metadata. Notices in packages/track/data/LICENSE-DATA.md

author: OpenStreetMap contributors; heights produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA
changes: Derived database built by tools/track-pipeline/build.py spa: OSM circuit relation 284560 and pit way 323851541 chained, projected, smoothed and resampled every 2 m; s scaled to 7004 m; heights from the Copernicus GLO-30 tile with a 90 m average and 20 m Gaussian and cubic corrections of three surface-model artefacts (Kemmel, the descent to Pouhon, after Blanchimont); gravel and barriers from OSM ways near the track (fences read as guard rails); authored widths, banking, kerbs, run-off kinds, barrier types and offsets, pit widths, limit lines, boxes and grid; timing line measured on the FIA 2025 circuit map; environment metadata. Notices in packages/track/data/LICENSE-DATA.md

author: OpenStreetMap contributors; heights produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA
changes: Derived database built by tools/track-pipeline/build.py singapore: OSM circuit relation 421263 and pit way 100484287 chained, projected, junction vertices rounded with 12 m arcs, smoothed and resampled every 2 m; s scaled to 4927 m; heights from the Copernicus GLO-30 tile with a 400 m opening, 90 m average and 20 m Gaussian, with the two OSM bridges re-inserted as crowned decks; widths from OSM lanes tags; authored banking, kerbs, run-off kinds, walls and escape roads, pit widths, limit lines, boxes and grid; timing line measured on the FIA 2025 circuit map; environment metadata with a floodlight placement rule. Notices in packages/track/data/LICENSE-DATA.md

author: OpenStreetMap contributors; heights produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA
changes: Derived database built by tools/dressing/build.py monza: OSM woods, tree rows, individual trees, meadows, service roads, grandstands, paddock buildings, bridges and historic banking projected into the circuit frame; canopy-filtered Copernicus GLO-30 terrain heights on a 50 m grid out to 6 km (400 m opening, 150 m average); authored bridge and big-screen placements from tools/dressing/circuits/monza.json; OpenStreetMap names dropped except those the renderer reads. Notices in packages/render/data/LICENSE-DATA.md
